items.title: M0 freeze ProofStory vocabulary and lifecycle documentation
items.context: Apply the approved intent_coverage_check ordering fix and ensure docs state candidate ledger, confirmed ledger, pre-DEV coverage, and no second lifecycle state machine.
items.userSees: The ProofStory plan shows the corrected lifecycle where ledger sizing comes before checklist, intent_coverage_check comes after checklist/verificationIntent/acceptance binding, and DONE evidence remains in delivery/equivalence checks.

happy.desc: The decision document states the corrected lifecycle order and uses five progressive model rules consistently.

edge.desc: The document distinguishes candidate milestone ledgers from confirmed ledgers before gate consumption.

adversarial.desc: The document does not imply intent_coverage_check can fully pass before checklist, verificationIntent, and acceptance binding exist.

items.title: M1 implement original intent and confirmed milestone ledger artifacts
items.context: Extend existing snapshot/ledger artifacts so ledgers distinguish candidate versus confirmed state and can bind to accepted intent interpretation without making candidate ledgers gate evidence.
items.userSees: ProofStory commands can store original intent snapshots and milestone ledgers with candidate/confirmed semantics and stable hashes.

happy.desc: original_intent_snapshot_set/get and milestone_ledger_set/add/get persist stable English artifacts with candidate and confirmed ledger semantics.

edge.desc: A candidate ledger is reported as not gate-consumed until accepted intent interpretation confirms it.

adversarial.desc: Changing the frozen original sourceText or key requirement ids is rejected instead of silently replacing the intent snapshot.

items.title: M2 implement dry-run hardening and ledger sizing diagnostics
items.context: Keep observe/warn behavior for dry-run diagnostics, including hardening classification, ledger sizing, too_broad/slice_required diagnostics, and no automatic child-story creation.
items.userSees: proofstory_gate_check --dryRun reports missing artifacts, hardening triggers, ledger size, thresholds, too_broad, and suggested slicing without mutating lifecycle state.

happy.desc: proofstory_gate_check --dryRun reports hardening level, triggers, ledger size, thresholds, and missing artifacts without changing lifecycle state.

edge.desc: A ledger above the story-size threshold produces too_broad and slice-plan diagnostics before DEV.

adversarial.desc: The diagnostic does not auto-create child stories or scheduler work when the ledger is oversized.

items.title: M3 implement intent collision artifact commands
items.context: Add structured intent_collision_set/get semantics so accepted intent interpretation can confirm ledgers and collision-required stories can be diagnosed or blocked by later gates.
items.userSees: A story can record accepted, revise_intent, human_gate, or stop intent collision outcomes and bind confirmed ledgers to accepted interpretation.

items.title: M4 implement ProofStory contract and pre-DEV gate enforcement
items.context: Implement acceptance contract bindings and proofstory gate enforcement/warn modes using existing lifecycle gates, without adding a second state machine.
items.userSees: Triggered stories get would-block diagnostics and enforce-mode can block DEV when required ProofStory artifacts are missing or inconsistent.

items.title: M5 implement scope shrinkage and DONE intent equivalence
items.context: Add scope shrinkage decisions and DONE intent equivalence checks so delivered output cannot be narrower than original intent without explicit confirmation.
items.userSees: DONE checks can compare original intent, confirmed ledger, delivery-check evidence, and any explicit shrinkage decision.

items.title: M6 implement red evidence artifacts and policy triggers
items.context: Add red_evidence commands and diagnostics for bug/regression/security/behavior-change/benchmark claims, keeping docs-only and normal new features exempt by default.
items.userSees: Risk-triggered stories can require red evidence while ordinary new features remain lightweight.

items.title: M7 implement spike evidence artifacts and policy triggers
items.context: Add spike commands and unresolved-spike diagnostics for unclear code paths, investigation wording, and high-assurance uncertainty.
items.userSees: Spike evidence can be recorded, resolved, discarded, or promoted without being mistaken for passing verificationEvidence.

items.title: M8 implement REVIEW completeness critic integration
items.context: Ensure REVIEW can detect incomplete ProofStory coverage and stale or missing review completeness evidence for triggered stories.
items.userSees: Reviewers see ProofStory completeness gaps and cannot accidentally pass a story whose checklist misses confirmed user intent.

items.title: M9 implement risk-adaptive enforcement rollout
items.context: Wire observe/warn/enforce modes so high-assurance and oversized-ledger cases can enforce gates while low-risk stories stay light.
items.userSees: ProofStory enforcement is progressive: Intent MVP stays small, triggered paths harden, and policy-controlled enforce mode blocks only when the document says it should.
